# Synthetic fixture (INF04-01): components that nothing in the template uses, and disabled triggers.
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Resources:
  FnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: lambda.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
  LegacyExport:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      Role: !GetAtt FnRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: "def handler(event, context): return event"
  LegacyExportLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${LegacyExport}
      RetentionInDays: 7
  LegacyExportErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref LegacyExport
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  ReportBuilder:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: report-builder
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt FnRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: "exports.handler = async () => ({})"
  ResizeImages:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      CodeUri: src/
  OldJobsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
  AlertsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: legacy-alerts
  NightlyCleanup:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      Role: !GetAtt FnRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: "def handler(event, context): return event"
  NightlyCleanupRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt NightlyCleanup.Arn
          Id: cleanup
  NightlyCleanupPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref NightlyCleanup
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt NightlyCleanupRule.Arn
  QuarterlyReport:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      Role: !GetAtt FnRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: "def handler(event, context): return event"
  QuarterlyReportScheduleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invoke
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt QuarterlyReport.Arn
  QuarterlyReportSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: cron(0 6 1 */3 ? *)
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: "OFF"
      State: DISABLED
      Target:
        Arn: !GetAtt QuarterlyReport.Arn
        RoleArn: !GetAtt QuarterlyReportScheduleRole.Arn
  IngestQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
  IngestWorker:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      Role: !GetAtt FnRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: "def handler(event, context): return event"
  IngestMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt IngestQueue.Arn
      FunctionName: !Ref IngestWorker
      Enabled: false
  WeeklyDigest:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      CodeUri: src/
      Events:
        Weekly:
          Type: Schedule
          Properties:
            Schedule: rate(7 days)
            Enabled: false
